values.Example: Everything is made of atoms.
values.ExampleTranslation: Mọi thứ đều được tạo nên từ nguyên tử.
values.MeaningEn: the smallest part of a chemical element

values.Example: The moon is very bright tonight.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tối nay mặt trăng rất sáng.
values.MeaningEn: the large round object that goes around the Earth
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The moon is very bright tonight.","vi":"T\u1ED1i nay m\u1EB7t tr\u0103ng r\u1EA5t s\u00E1ng."},{"text":"Astronauts first walked on the moon in 1969.","vi":"C\u00E1c phi h\u00E0nh gia l\u1EA7n \u0111\u1EA7u \u0111\u1EB7t ch\u00E2n l\u00EAn m\u1EB7t tr\u0103ng v\u00E0o n\u0103m 1969."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"full moon","vi":"tr\u0103ng tr\u00F2n"},{"text":"walk on the moon","vi":"\u0111i b\u1ED9 tr\u00EAn m\u1EB7t tr\u0103ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Thousands of people watched the solar eclipse.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hàng nghìn người đã xem nhật thực.
values.MeaningEn: an event when the sun or moon is hidden by another object
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Thousands of people watched the solar eclipse.","vi":"H\u00E0ng ngh\u00ECn ng\u01B0\u1EDDi \u0111\u00E3 xem nh\u1EADt th\u1EF1c."},{"text":"The eclipse lasted about two minutes.","vi":"Hi\u1EC7n t\u01B0\u1EE3ng th\u1EF1c k\u00E9o d\u00E0i kho\u1EA3ng hai ph\u00FAt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"solar eclipse","vi":"nh\u1EADt th\u1EF1c"},{"text":"lunar eclipse","vi":"nguy\u1EC7t th\u1EF1c"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The astronauts live on the space station for six months.
values.ExampleTranslation: Các phi hành gia sống trên trạm vũ trụ sáu tháng.
values.MeaningEn: a large structure in space where astronauts live and work
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The astronauts live on the space station for six months.","vi":"C\u00E1c phi h\u00E0nh gia s\u1ED1ng tr\u00EAn tr\u1EA1m v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 s\u00E1u th\u00E1ng."},{"text":"You can sometimes see the space station in the night sky.","vi":"\u0110\u00F4i khi b\u1EA1n c\u00F3 th\u1EC3 th\u1EA5y tr\u1EA1m v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 tr\u00EAn b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi \u0111\u00EAm."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"International Space Station","vi":"Tr\u1EA1m v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 qu\u1ED1c t\u1EBF"},{"text":"live on a space station","vi":"s\u1ED1ng tr\u00EAn tr\u1EA1m v\u0169 tr\u1EE5"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: There is a periodic table on the classroom wall.
values.ExampleTranslation: Có một bảng tuần hoàn trên tường lớp học.
values.MeaningEn: a chart that shows all the chemical elements
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"There is a periodic table on the classroom wall.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t b\u1EA3ng tu\u1EA7n ho\u00E0n tr\u00EAn t\u01B0\u1EDDng l\u1EDBp h\u1ECDc."},{"text":"Hydrogen is the first element in the periodic table.","vi":"Hydro l\u00E0 nguy\u00EAn t\u1ED1 \u0111\u1EA7u ti\u00EAn trong b\u1EA3ng tu\u1EA7n ho\u00E0n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"learn the periodic table","vi":"h\u1ECDc b\u1EA3ng tu\u1EA7n ho\u00E0n"},{"text":"periodic table of elements","vi":"b\u1EA3ng tu\u1EA7n ho\u00E0n c\u00E1c nguy\u00EAn t\u1ED1"}],"wordFamily":[]}
values.ImageSourceJson: {"provider":"upload","pageUrl":"https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Periodic_Table_-_Atomic_Properties_of_the_Elements.png","author":"R.A. Dragoset, A. Musgrove, C.W. Clark, and W.C. Martin \u2014 NIST, Physical Measurement Laboratory"}

values.Example: We looked at a leaf under the microscope.

values.MeaningEn: an instrument that makes very small things look bigger
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We looked at a leaf under the microscope.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i quan s\u00E1t m\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc l\u00E1 d\u01B0\u1EDBi k\u00EDnh hi\u1EC3n vi."},{"text":"The microscope is on the lab table.","vi":"Chi\u1EBFc k\u00EDnh hi\u1EC3n vi n\u1EB1m tr\u00EAn b\u00E0n th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"under a microscope","vi":"d\u01B0\u1EDBi k\u00EDnh hi\u1EC3n vi"},{"text":"electron microscope","vi":"k\u00EDnh hi\u1EC3n vi \u0111i\u1EC7n t\u1EED"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The astronaut waved from the spacecraft.

values.MeaningEn: a person who travels in space
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The astronaut waved from the spacecraft.","vi":"Phi h\u00E0nh gia v\u1EABy tay t\u1EEB t\u00E0u v\u0169 tr\u1EE5."},{"text":"Many children dream of becoming an astronaut.","vi":"Nhi\u1EC1u tr\u1EBB em m\u01A1 \u01B0\u1EDBc tr\u1EDF th\u00E0nh phi h\u00E0nh gia."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"become an astronaut","vi":"tr\u1EDF th\u00E0nh phi h\u00E0nh gia"},{"text":"astronaut training","vi":"hu\u1EA5n luy\u1EC7n phi h\u00E0nh gia"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The scientist put on a white lab coat.

values.MeaningEn: a white coat that scientists wear to protect their clothes
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The scientist put on a white lab coat.","vi":"Nh\u00E0 khoa h\u1ECDc m\u1EB7c chi\u1EBFc \u00E1o cho\u00E0ng ph\u00F2ng th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m m\u00E0u tr\u1EAFng."},{"text":"Students must wear a lab coat in the laboratory.","vi":"H\u1ECDc sinh ph\u1EA3i m\u1EB7c \u00E1o cho\u00E0ng khi \u1EDF ph\u00F2ng th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"wear a lab coat","vi":"m\u1EB7c \u00E1o cho\u00E0ng ph\u00F2ng th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m"},{"text":"white lab coat","vi":"\u00E1o cho\u00E0ng tr\u1EAFng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We saw a meteor flash across the sky.

values.MeaningEn: a small piece of rock that burns brightly as it falls through the sky
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We saw a meteor flash across the sky.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i th\u1EA5y m\u1ED9t v\u1EC7t sao b\u0103ng l\u00F3e qua b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi."},{"text":"Make a wish when you see a meteor.","vi":"H\u00E3y \u01B0\u1EDBc m\u1ED9t \u0111i\u1EC1u khi b\u1EA1n th\u1EA5y sao b\u0103ng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"meteor shower","vi":"m\u01B0a sao b\u0103ng"},{"text":"see a meteor","vi":"th\u1EA5y sao b\u0103ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Definition: miệng núi lửa, hố va chạm
values.Example: The moon has thousands of craters.
values.ExampleTranslation: Mặt trăng có hàng nghìn hố va chạm.
values.MeaningEn: a large round hole in the ground or on the moon
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The moon has thousands of craters.","vi":"M\u1EB7t tr\u0103ng c\u00F3 h\u00E0ng ngh\u00ECn h\u1ED1 va ch\u1EA1m."},{"text":"We walked to the edge of the volcano crater.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111i t\u1EDBi m\u00E9p mi\u1EC7ng n\u00FAi l\u1EEDa."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"volcano crater","vi":"mi\u1EC7ng n\u00FAi l\u1EEDa"},{"text":"deep crater","vi":"h\u1ED1 s\u00E2u"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He found a fossil of a shell on the beach.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cậu ấy tìm thấy một hóa thạch vỏ sò trên bãi biển.
values.MeaningEn: the hard remains of an ancient plant or animal in rock
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"He found a fossil of a shell on the beach.","vi":"C\u1EADu \u1EA5y t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y m\u1ED9t h\u00F3a th\u1EA1ch v\u1ECF s\u00F2 tr\u00EAn b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"The museum has a dinosaur fossil.","vi":"B\u1EA3o t\u00E0ng c\u00F3 m\u1ED9t h\u00F3a th\u1EA1ch kh\u1EE7ng long."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"dinosaur fossil","vi":"h\u00F3a th\u1EA1ch kh\u1EE7ng long"},{"text":"find a fossil","vi":"t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y h\u00F3a th\u1EA1ch"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We did an experiment with water and salt.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi làm một thí nghiệm với nước và muối.
values.MeaningEn: a scientific test to find out if an idea is true
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We did an experiment with water and salt.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i l\u00E0m m\u1ED9t th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m v\u1EDBi n\u01B0\u1EDBc v\u00E0 mu\u1ED1i."},{"text":"The experiment did not work the first time.","vi":"Th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m kh\u00F4ng th\u00E0nh c\u00F4ng \u1EDF l\u1EA7n \u0111\u1EA7u."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"carry out an experiment","vi":"ti\u1EBFn h\u00E0nh th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m"},{"text":"science experiment","vi":"th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m khoa h\u1ECDc"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.

values.MeaningEn: a huge group of stars, gas and dust
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.","vi":"Thi\u00EAn h\u00E0 c\u1EE7a ch\u00FAng ta c\u00F3 t\u00EAn l\u00E0 D\u1EA3i Ng\u00E2n H\u00E0."},{"text":"There are billions of galaxies in space.","vi":"C\u00F3 h\u00E0ng t\u1EF7 thi\u00EAn h\u00E0 trong v\u0169 tr\u1EE5."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"distant galaxy","vi":"thi\u00EAn h\u00E0 xa x\u00F4i"},{"text":"spiral galaxy","vi":"thi\u00EAn h\u00E0 xo\u1EAFn \u1ED1c"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.MeaningEn: the curved path of an object moving around a planet or star
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The satellite is in orbit around the Earth.","vi":"V\u1EC7 tinh \u0111ang \u1EDF tr\u00EAn qu\u1EF9 \u0111\u1EA1o quanh Tr\u00E1i \u0110\u1EA5t."},{"text":"Earth takes a year to complete its orbit.","vi":"Tr\u00E1i \u0110\u1EA5t m\u1EA5t m\u1ED9t n\u0103m \u0111\u1EC3 ho\u00E0n th\u00E0nh qu\u1EF9 \u0111\u1EA1o c\u1EE7a n\u00F3."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"in orbit","vi":"tr\u00EAn qu\u1EF9 \u0111\u1EA1o"},{"text":"orbit around the sun","vi":"qu\u1EF9 \u0111\u1EA1o quanh m\u1EB7t tr\u1EDDi"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A comet crossed the night sky last week.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một sao chổi đã băng qua bầu trời đêm tuần trước.
values.MeaningEn: a bright object in space with a long tail of light
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A comet crossed the night sky last week.","vi":"M\u1ED9t sao ch\u1ED5i \u0111\u00E3 b\u0103ng qua b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi \u0111\u00EAm tu\u1EA7n tr\u01B0\u1EDBc."},{"text":"The comet is visible only for a few days.","vi":"Sao ch\u1ED5i ch\u1EC9 nh\u00ECn th\u1EA5y \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c trong v\u00E0i ng\u00E0y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"bright comet","vi":"sao ch\u1ED5i s\u00E1ng"},{"text":"comet tail","vi":"\u0111u\u00F4i sao ch\u1ED5i"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He watched the moon through a telescope.

values.Example: A magnet can pick up small iron nails.

values.MeaningEn: a piece of metal that pulls iron towards it
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A magnet can pick up small iron nails.","vi":"Nam ch\u00E2m c\u00F3 th\u1EC3 nh\u1EB7t nh\u1EEFng chi\u1EBFc \u0111inh s\u1EAFt nh\u1ECF."},{"text":"The children played with a magnet in science class.","vi":"B\u1ECDn tr\u1EBB ngh\u1ECBch nam ch\u00E2m trong gi\u1EDD khoa h\u1ECDc."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"strong magnet","vi":"nam ch\u00E2m m\u1EA1nh"},{"text":"fridge magnet","vi":"nam ch\u00E2m d\u00E1n t\u1EE7 l\u1EA1nh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.MeaningEn: a group of atoms joined together
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms.","vi":"M\u1ED9t ph\u00E2n t\u1EED n\u01B0\u1EDBc c\u00F3 hai nguy\u00EAn t\u1EED hydro."},{"text":"The students built a molecule from plastic balls.","vi":"H\u1ECDc sinh gh\u00E9p m\u1ED9t ph\u00E2n t\u1EED b\u1EB1ng nh\u1EEFng qu\u1EA3 b\u00F3ng nh\u1EF1a."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"water molecule","vi":"ph\u00E2n t\u1EED n\u01B0\u1EDBc"},{"text":"molecule model","vi":"m\u00F4 h\u00ECnh ph\u00E2n t\u1EED"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The spacecraft landed safely on the moon.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tàu vũ trụ đã hạ cánh an toàn lên mặt trăng.
values.MeaningEn: a vehicle that travels in space
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The spacecraft landed safely on the moon.","vi":"T\u00E0u v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 \u0111\u00E3 h\u1EA1 c\u00E1nh an to\u00E0n l\u00EAn m\u1EB7t tr\u0103ng."},{"text":"Engineers built a new spacecraft last year.","vi":"C\u00E1c k\u1EF9 s\u01B0 \u0111\u00E3 ch\u1EBF t\u1EA1o m\u1ED9t t\u00E0u v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 m\u1EDBi v\u00E0o n\u0103m ngo\u00E1i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"launch a spacecraft","vi":"ph\u00F3ng t\u00E0u v\u0169 tr\u1EE5"},{"text":"manned spacecraft","vi":"t\u00E0u v\u0169 tr\u1EE5 c\u00F3 ng\u01B0\u1EDDi l\u00E1i"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He used a magnifying glass to read the tiny letters.
values.ExampleTranslation: Anh ấy dùng kính lúp để đọc những chữ nhỏ xíu.
values.MeaningEn: a lens that makes small things look bigger
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"He used a magnifying glass to read the tiny letters.","vi":"Anh \u1EA5y d\u00F9ng k\u00EDnh l\u00FAp \u0111\u1EC3 \u0111\u1ECDc nh\u1EEFng ch\u1EEF nh\u1ECF x\u00EDu."},{"text":"The detective held up a magnifying glass.","vi":"Th\u00E1m t\u1EED gi\u01A1 cao chi\u1EBFc k\u00EDnh l\u00FAp."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"hold a magnifying glass","vi":"c\u1EA7m k\u00EDnh l\u00FAp"},{"text":"use a magnifying glass","vi":"d\u00F9ng k\u00EDnh l\u00FAp"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: DNA decides the colour of your eyes.
values.ExampleTranslation: ADN quyết định màu mắt của bạn.
values.MeaningEn: the material in cells that carries the information about a living thing
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"DNA decides the colour of your eyes.","vi":"ADN quy\u1EBFt \u0111\u1ECBnh m\u00E0u m\u1EAFt c\u1EE7a b\u1EA1n."},{"text":"Scientists studied the DNA from the sample.","vi":"C\u00E1c nh\u00E0 khoa h\u1ECDc nghi\u00EAn c\u1EE9u ADN t\u1EEB m\u1EABu v\u1EADt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"DNA test","vi":"x\u00E9t nghi\u1EC7m ADN"},{"text":"human DNA","vi":"ADN ng\u01B0\u1EDDi"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: An asteroid passed close to the Earth.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một tiểu hành tinh bay ngang qua gần Trái Đất.
values.MeaningEn: a small rocky object that moves around the sun
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"An asteroid passed close to the Earth.","vi":"M\u1ED9t ti\u1EC3u h\u00E0nh tinh bay ngang qua g\u1EA7n Tr\u00E1i \u0110\u1EA5t."},{"text":"Scientists study asteroids to learn about the solar system.","vi":"C\u00E1c nh\u00E0 khoa h\u1ECDc nghi\u00EAn c\u1EE9u ti\u1EC3u h\u00E0nh tinh \u0111\u1EC3 hi\u1EC3u v\u1EC1 h\u1EC7 m\u1EB7t tr\u1EDDi."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"asteroid belt","vi":"v\u00E0nh \u0111ai ti\u1EC3u h\u00E0nh tinh"},{"text":"giant asteroid","vi":"ti\u1EC3u h\u00E0nh tinh kh\u1ED5ng l\u1ED3"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He heated the water in a beaker.
values.ExampleTranslation: Anh ấy đun nước trong một cốc thí nghiệm.
values.MeaningEn: a glass container with a flat bottom used in a laboratory
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"He heated the water in a beaker.","vi":"Anh \u1EA5y \u0111un n\u01B0\u1EDBc trong m\u1ED9t c\u1ED1c th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m."},{"text":"The beaker is half full of blue liquid.","vi":"Chi\u1EBFc c\u1ED1c th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m \u0111\u1EA7y m\u1ED9t n\u1EEDa ch\u1EA5t l\u1ECFng m\u00E0u xanh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"glass beaker","vi":"c\u1ED1c th\u1EE7y tinh th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m"},{"text":"fill a beaker","vi":"r\u00F3t \u0111\u1EA7y c\u1ED1c th\u00ED nghi\u1EC7m"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun.
